Spider-Man: Brand New Day Film Achieves High Box Office Collections in India

The film 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day', starring Tom Holland, has achieved significant box office success in India. Within seven days of its release, the movie has reportedly earned ₹318.45 crore in India. It has also been described as the highest-grossing film of 2026 in India and worldwide within its opening week. Additionally, Bisleri has launched limited-edition packs and merchandise featuring Spider-Man to coincide with the film's release.
